name: retrobook
description: RetroBook — a rede social das comunidades literarias.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @retrobook/api && npm run build --workspace @retrobook/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @retrobook/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @retrobook/web
